textTemplates.description: User action text describing the Deactivate process.
textTemplates.name: ttUserActionDeactivate
textTemplates.text: Thank you. We have temporarily deactivated the user {!vUser.Username}. If this user requires access in the future, you can simply reactivate the user.

textTemplates.description: Holds the text displayed when a user is permanently disabled.
textTemplates.name: ttUserActionDisable
textTemplates.text: Thank you. We have permanently disabled the user {!vUser.Username}. If this user requires access in the future, you will have to recreate the user on the same Contact record.

textTemplates.description: Text displayed when a user was reactivated.
textTemplates.name: ttUserActionReactivate
textTemplates.text: Thank you. We have reactivated the user {!vUser.Username}. This user can now log in to Experience Sites where membership was set.

textTemplates.name: ttUserDetails
textTemplates.text:
USERNAME: {!vUser.Username}

EMAIL: {!vUser.Email}

PROFILE: {!vUser.Profile.Name}


LAST LOGIN: {!vLastLoginDateTime}

PASSWORD LAST RESET: {!vLastPasswordResetDateTime}

FAILED LOGIN ATTEMPTS: {!vNumberFailedLogins}
